summary: The DGA checkbox: a native checkbox, visually replaced by a token-styled box, with its label, hint and error. A signal-model control: bind [(checked)] or a signal-forms field.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label (translated); projected content follows it.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the checkbox invalid.

inputs.name: indeterminate
inputs.description: Mixed state (a dash) until the user toggles.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Native required plus a decorative asterisk.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the checkbox invalid without a message.

outputs.name: checkedChange
outputs.description: The new state when the user toggles (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true on the first blur.

slots.description: Extra label content after label, for example a link to terms.

a11y: A native input type=checkbox inside its label, so clicking the text toggles it and Space toggles from the keyboard. indeterminate uses the native mixed state. Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid. The drawn box and asterisk are aria-hidden.
